findings_qualitative.value: ALMA non-detection implies a low host star formation rate.

claims.hypothesis: Is the FRB hosted in a prominent star-forming galaxy?
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 6 imaging at the burst position
claims.result: No source; 3 sigma < 51 uJy gives SFR < 0.06-19 Msun/yr
claims.finding: Host has low star formation; a prominent star-forming host is disfavoured

evidence.quote: Our observations are inconsistent with the fast radio burst having a Galactic origin or its source being located within a prominent star-forming galaxy.
